title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 exhaustion gate broken for same-day stale bounces — RFC3339 'T' vs ::text ' ' lexical compare treats every same-day redelivered pre-correction failure as genuine
detail: matched_send_at is RFC3339 ('T', sweep.gleam:180 to_rfc3339); corrected_at::text is space-separated. 'T'(0x54) > ' '(0x20) at index 10, so ANY same-calendar-day bounce compares as post-correction — a redelivered pre-correction bounce on the correction day still exhausts and fabricates referee_contact_invalid. Both pinning tests use only cross-day timestamps (fixed 2026-08-01 vs now()).
recommended_fix: Normalise both sides (timestamptz comparison in SQL, or parse both in Gleam) before comparing; add a same-day stale-bounce test (pre-correction send_ref redelivered on the same calendar day as corrected_at) asserting stand-down + no stamp.

title: Substitute creation-fraud stamping (r1 N1 fix) is untested — the substituted row's fraud_signals are never asserted
evidence:
actions_handler.gleam:417-424:
      // r1 (N1): the new row gets the same creation-time fraud screening the
      // viewed trigger applies (parity — best-effort, post-commit).
      trigger.stamp_creation_fraud_for(
        config,
        app_uuid,
        landlord_uuid,
        vacancy_uuid,
        [new_id],
      )
Substitute tests (lines 668-811) assert only row count/status/contact/audit; the only fraud_signals assertions in the file (lines 610, 992, 1061) cover the exhaustion stamp, never substitute creation.
detail: do_substitute stamps creation-time fraud signals on the new row (N1 fix), but no test asserts the substituted row's fraud_signals. The trigger path has trigger_stamps_creation_fraud_signals_test; the substitute path has zero pin — a regression dropping the stamp would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Extend substitute_creates_new_row_and_audits_old_and_new_ids_test (or add a sibling) asserting the successor row's fraud_signals jsonb is non-null and carries the creation keys, mirroring the trigger suite's pin.

title: Authz negatives missing on the new action endpoints — no non-owning-landlord 404 and no archived-vacancy 422 test drives take-over/correct/substitute
evidence:
actions_handler.gleam:556-566:
    sql.verify_application_in_vacancy(db, app_uuid, vacancy_uuid, landlord_uuid)
  ...
      case app_sql.verify_vacancy_active(db, vacancy_uuid, landlord_uuid) {
        Ok(pog.Returned(_, [vacancy_row])) if vacancy_row.is_archived ->
          ... 422
Integration file: cross_vacancy_application_id_is_not_found_test (1252) and correct_validation_and_cross_application_guards_test (500) exercise only the 404 branch via same-owner mismatches; the only archived-vacancy 422 test is handle_start_archived_vacancy_is_unavailable_test (trigger suite, start endpoint only).
detail: Shared prechecks are exercised, but neither the owner-mismatch 404 (vacancy.user_id != caller) nor the archived-vacancy 422 branch is tested through any of the three new action endpoints. The r1 N3 lesson — wiring-level tests prove the chain — applies here too.
recommended_fix: Add a test calling handle_correct/handle_take_over/handle_substitute with a different landlord's vacancy (expect 404) and one against an archived vacancy (expect 422), mirroring the trigger suite's cross-tenant and archived tests.
